event.checkLogin: Web Learning needs a sign-in check

outputTruncated: The Web Learning adapter output exceeded the 1 MB limit and was truncated
loginHint: Sign in to Web Learning and complete any verification in the owner's private chat.
invalidJson: The OneLearn adapter didn't return valid JSON
noCommand: Configure the OneLearn adapter process command
firstSync: First sync: recorded {count} assignments as the baseline
adapterExited: The Web Learning adapter process exited abnormally (exit code {exit_code}): {detail}

tools.query: Query courses, announcements, unsubmitted homework, course files, and homework attachments; homework_detail needs homework_id and returns one assignment's details. When authentication is needed, use the school plugin's login and verification code tools.
tools.download: Download a course file or homework attachment to this plugin's private folder. download needs course_id + file_id (from the files query); download_homework_attachment needs homework_id + file_id (from the homework_attachments query).
